flags.why: The dated tag misleadingly implies that this visa term is no longer current, although it remains in [present-day official Vietnamese usage](https://dcj.nsw.gov.au/content/dcj/dcj-website/dcj/children-and-families/family-domestic-and-sexual-violence/about-domestic-and-family-violence/coercive-control/coercive-control-vietnamese/easy-read/page-2.html).
In the example, chiếu is the verb and ánh nắng is its object; chiếu ánh is not a standalone verb meaning to illuminate.
flags.fix: Remove this sense under chiếu ánh; the illustrated verb is chiếu.
